transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’ve just been more tense and kind of down lately. I was trying to clean up my image and routine for some arts board stuff, and it’s... not going as smoothly as I thought. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep dropping little stuff I’d normally care about, like fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel bad about it and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Are you still enjoying the things you normally like to do?
I’m not really sure. I still… do some of the things, I guess. It just doesn’t feel as easy to get into them lately.
Do you feel like you're getting any pleasure from the things you're still doing?
Some, maybe. Like, if I’m already doing it, there are moments where it’s okay. But it’s not really… the same pull to it, I guess.
Have you lost any weight recently?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been checking, but my clothes seem about the same.
Do you feel anxious or on edge most of the time?

Most of the time might be a little strong, but… yeah, I’ve been more tense than usual. Since I started trying to fix my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I feel kind of on edge, and then I mess up little things I normally care about and feel bad about it.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the tension and lack of enjoyment in activities?
Um… about two months, I think. Since I started trying to change my routine and how I present myself. It’s been kind of there since then.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt overwhelmed, but not like I want to hurt myself.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things that have happened?

Yeah… I do. Mostly over little things, I guess. Like if I don’t keep up with fair planning notes or design drafts, I end up blaming myself and then I just cancel plans instead of catching up. It feels… kind of stupid, but I do feel guilty about it.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy and look forward to?

A little, yeah… I still care about the arts board and fair stuff, like the planning notes or design drafts. I don’t know if I’d say I really look forward to it lately, though. I’m doing the basics, but I keep dropping little parts of it, and then I feel bad and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Do you often feel worthless or like you're not good enough?

Sometimes, yeah. Not all the time. It’s more like… when I’m trying to keep up with the arts board stuff and I drop little things, like fair notes or drafts, I start feeling like I’m not doing enough. Then I feel guilty and kind of pull back or cancel plans instead of just fixing it.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
I don’t think so… nothing I’ve really noticed. Maybe it varies a little day to day, but not in a big way.
Have you ever felt this way before, with tension and lack of enjoyment in activities, at any other time in your life?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had it quite like this before… at least not that I remember.
Have you ever felt this low or tense before in your life?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had stressful times before, but… I can’t say I remember feeling exactly like this.
Have you had any thoughts about wanting to be dead?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really had thoughts like that.
Do you feel like these feelings of tension and lack of enjoyment are interfering with your daily life most of the time?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still doing the basic things I need to do, but I’m not as dependable with the volunteer stuff and creative projects people usually expect me to handle. Like fair planning or following through on design things… I’ve been slipping more than I’d like.
Do you feel like these feelings of tension and lack of enjoyment are present every day?
I’m not sure it’s every day. It’s… pretty often, but I haven’t really been keeping track like that.
Do you feel like these feelings of tension and lack of enjoyment are present most of the day?
I’m not really sure. It comes and goes… I don’t think I’ve paid attention to whether it’s most of the day.
How many days a week would you say you've been feeling this tension and lack of enjoyment?
I’m not really sure… maybe a few days? I haven’t been counting it closely.
For how long have you been feeling like activities don't have the same pull to them as they used to?
Um… maybe around two months. It kind of started when I was trying to change my routine and how I present myself, I guess.
Would you say these feelings of tension and lack of enjoyment have been present for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two months?
I don’t know if it’s been most of the day every day. It’s been going on about two months, though… since I started trying to change my routine and how I present myself.
